name: Baked plantain chips
steps: Toss with the coconut oil and a pinch of turmeric, then bake at 180C until crisp, turning once.

name: Kerala-style roasted chickpeas
steps: Pat the cooked chickpeas dry and toss with the olive oil and black pepper.
Roast at 200C, shaking occasionally, until golden and crisp.

name: Steamed banana with honey
steps: Steam the peeled banana for 5 minutes until soft.
Slice and drizzle with the honey to serve.

name: Fruit and coconut chaat
steps: Dice the mixed fruit and toss with the lime juice.
Scatter the desiccated coconut over the top to serve.

name: Spiced popcorn
steps: Pop the popcorn kernels in the olive oil in a covered pan over a medium heat.
Toss with the chilli powder and a pinch of salt while still warm.

name: Kothimbir vadi
steps: Mix the besan with the chopped coriander, cumin, and enough water to form a thick batter; steam in a shallow tin for 15 minutes.
Slice into pieces and lightly pan-fry until golden on both sides to serve.

name: Bhel puri
steps: Toss the puffed rice with the diced tomatoes and onion.
Drizzle with the tamarind paste and toss again just before serving so the puffed rice stays crisp.

name: Sprouted bean salad
steps: Toss the sprouted bean mix with the diced tomatoes and onion.
Season with lime juice, salt, and a pinch of chilli powder to serve.
